g.text: QRWTY | a quick link without an account
PROPOSED — product logic authored after generation. A public slug is never proof of ownership.
Solid arrow: request / read Dashed arrow: queued delivery Amber: product rule
No login redirect. A failed write cannot return a successful short link.
Store only a verifier hash; encrypt any proof-bearing retry payload. Never log or put the proof in a QR.
They cannot edit or see analytics.
Default to confirm: guest links do not automatically expire. Accounts are required for saved management.
